enabled.description: To enable or disable email/password authentication.

oauth.description: OAuth configuration. Leave `undefined` to disable OAuth signups.

additionalProperties.description: the provider name. Compatible providers: Apple Discord Facebook GitHub Google Hugging Face Kick Microsoft Slack Notion Tiktok Twitch Twitter (X) Dropbox Linear LinkedIn GitLab Reddit Roblox Spotify VK Zoom

clientId.description: The client ID for the OAuth provider.

clientKey.description: The OAuth provider's client key, if applicable.

clientSecret.description: The client secret for the OAuth provider.

issuer.description: The OAuth provider's issuer, if applicable.

secret.description: The JWT secret used to sign tokens.

trustedOrigins.description: Trusted origins for authentication requests. Defaults to the origin header

turnstile.description: Cloudflare turnstile configuration. Leave `undefined` to disable turnstile.

databaseUrl.description: The URL of the database to connect to.

metadataUrl.description: The public URL of your Stardust instance. Use this if you want to display site metadata.

accessType.description: Access type for the authorization request. Use "offline" to request a refresh token.

authorizationHeaders.description: Custom headers to include in the authorization request. Useful for providers like Qonto that require specific headers (e.g., X-Qonto-Staging-Token for local development).

authorizationUrl.description: URL for the authorization endpoint. Optional if using discoveryUrl.

authorizationUrlParams.description: Additional search-params to add to the authorizationUrl. Warning: Search-params added here overwrite any default params.

disableImplicitSignUp.description: Disable implicit sign up for new users. When set to true for the provider, sign-in need to be called with with requestSignUp as true to create new users.

disableSignUp.description: Disable sign up for new users.

discoveryHeaders.description: Custom headers to include in the discovery request. Useful for providers like Epic that require specific headers (e.g., Epic-Client-ID).

discoveryUrl.description: URL to fetch OAuth 2.0 configuration. If provided, the authorization and token endpoints will be fetched from this URL.

overrideUserInfo.description:
Override user info with the provider info.

This will update the user info with the provider info, when the user signs in with the provider.

pkce.description: Whether to use PKCE (Proof Key for Code Exchange)

prompt.description: Prompt parameter for the authorization request. Controls the authentication experience for the user.

providerId.description: Unique identifier for the OAuth provider

redirectURI.description: Custom redirect URI. If not provided, a default URI will be constructed.

responseMode.description: The response mode to use for the authorization code request.

scopes.description: Array of OAuth scopes to request.

tokenUrl.description: URL for the token endpoint. Optional if using discoveryUrl.

tokenUrlParams.description: Additional search-params to add to the tokenUrl. Warning: Search-params added here overwrite any default params.

userInfoUrl.description: URL for the user info endpoint. Optional if using discoveryUrl.

id.description: ID of the node. Make it a unique string that helps identify it. This MUST be under 16 characters or issues can happen.

proto.description: Protocol to use for the node

keepaliveDuration.description: The amount of time to keep an inactive session alive for, in minutes.

uploadLimit.description: Upload limit. Maximum size of a single file upload, in megabytes. increasing this limit can lead to consumption of excessive server resources in parsing large amounts of data, as well as potential DDoS attacks

secret.description: The Turnstile secret key, used by the backend

siteKey.description: The Turnstile site key, used by the frontend
